Now I can see the issue! Looking at lines 2115-2140 in `/testbed/django/contrib/admin/options.py`:

For auto-created intermediate models (like ManyToMany through tables), the `has_add_permission`, `has_change_permission`, and `has_delete_permission` methods all return `self.has_view_permission(request, obj)`. 

This means if a user only has **view** permission (not change), they still get:
- `has_add_permission` → True (because they have view)
- `has_change_permission` → True (because they have view)
- `has_delete_permission` → True (because they have view)
